gemini.reasoning_note: Gemini 2.5+ are thinking models. thinkingBudget=0 (true single-pass) is accepted on Flash / Flash-Lite. On gemini-2.5-pro thinkingBudget cannot be set to 0 (adaptive thinking is not fully disableable) -> comparability caveat.

GEMINI_HIGH_CAPABILITY.rationale: Strongest CURRENT STABLE Gemini text model; newest generation (3.7); 1M input / 65k output; supports generateContent + responseSchema; can run true single-pass via thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget=0, giving clean reasoning-parity with the Anthropic reference. Preview Pro (gemini-3.1-pro-preview) is excluded per the avoid-preview-when-stable-exists rule.
GEMINI_HIGH_CAPABILITY.alternative_if_pro_tier_wanted: gemini-2.5-pro (only STABLE Pro-tier id) — accept a comparability caveat: adaptive thinking is not fully disableable on 2.5-pro.
GEMINI_HIGH_CAPABILITY.alternative_higher_ceiling_preview: gemini-3.1-pro-preview (PREVIEW — use only if the user accepts preview status)

GEMINI_COST_QUALITY.rationale: Newest STABLE Flash-Lite (cost/latency tier), same 1M/65k envelope, generateContent + responseSchema, single-pass capable (thinkingBudget=0). Clearly the lower-cost/faster class vs the high-capability pick; not an ultra-small model.

qwen.reasoning_note: The standard qwen3.x-max / qwen3.x-flash ids are non-thinking by default via compatible-mode. Explicit -thinking ids (e.g. qwen3-235b-a22b-thinking-2507) are separate and NOT selected. Some Qwen3 models honour extra_body={'enable_thinking': false} to force non-thinking — set it defensively.

QWEN_HIGH_CAPABILITY.rationale: Strongest CURRENT STABLE Qwen family (3.8 generation, Max tier); Chinese-native; OpenAI-compatible via compatible-mode; standard non-thinking production inference. Chosen over -thinking variants and over smaller dense open-weights.
QWEN_HIGH_CAPABILITY.alternative_pinned_build: qwen3.7-max-2026-06-08 (dated / more reproducible if an undated -max pointer is a concern)

QWEN_COST_QUALITY.rationale: Newest STABLE Qwen Flash tier (cost/quality), same 3.8 generation as the high-capability pick, strong Chinese semantics, OpenAI-compatible. Not qwen-turbo / the tiny dense variants (below the 'not merely smallest' rule).

DEEPSEEK_HIGH_VALUE.rationale: Flagship non-experimental DeepSeek chat model; strong general reasoning + Chinese capability; standard production OpenAI-compatible API. ONE variant only (deepseek-v4-flash not added — role is HIGH_VALUE, and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp is experimental).
DEEPSEEK_HIGH_VALUE.alternative_cheaper: deepseek-v4-flash (only if the user prefers the cost tier for the single DeepSeek slot)

moonshot.reasoning_note: kimi-k3 supports_thinking_type='only' -> reasoning is MANDATORY / non-disableable; default_effort='max'. reasoning_comparability_flag=true. Eval adapter to request reasoning_effort='low' for parity (if accepted); never high/max; do not compensate other candidates. Same handling class as deepseek-v4-pro.

KIMI_CHINESE_HIGH_CAPABILITY.rationale: Newest generation (k3 vs k2.x); 1,048,576-token context (4x the kimi-k2.6 alternative); dedicated reasoning-effort control (low/high/max); OpenAI-compatible; NOT a coding-specialised variant (kimi-k2.7-code* excluded per selection criterion 10); strong Chinese-native model — direct product-fit for the 90%-Chinese Dataset V1. Capability gap vs kimi-k2.6 is substantial, so the HIGH_CAPABILITY slot takes k3 despite no explicit stable/preview marker in /models metadata.
KIMI_CHINESE_HIGH_CAPABILITY.alternative_lower_capability: kimi-k2.6 (prior generation; 262,144 context; reasoning appears optional)
